llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed teacher-facing report assistant that reads scoped student learning records and drafts reports without sending messages or changing student status.

dimensions.detail: It handles sensitive longitudinal learning records for minors, but the artifact narrows access to relevant workspace fields and explicitly excludes real names, contact details, family details, and unsupported claims.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is Markdown and JSON guidance only; no executable scripts, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, or command execution behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires a named student before reading records, forbids cross-student or full-database summaries, checks parent communication consent before parent-visible output, and leaves sending to the teacher.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill can write confirmed stage evidence to progressEvidence and delete only its own stage-evidence entries after confirmation; it does not alter student cards, course ledgers, authorization fields, schedules, or parent communication logs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to generate stage and renewal reports from existing learning records, and the declared reads and limited write to progressEvidence fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if your use case is a Chinese K12 independent-teacher workflow and you are comfortable allowing the skill to read one named student's lesson, homework, progress, course-package, consent, and prior parent-communication summary fields to draft a report. Parent-facing content still requires the recorded consent checks and manual teacher review before sending.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language grade-band guidance aligns with the skill's declared Chinese K12 teaching context and does not add hidden authority or unsafe behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: The platform conventions explicitly scope the repository to Mainland China Chinese K12 scenarios and require localization before other-region deployment, so the locale constraint is disclosed rather than hidden.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese report templates are consistent with the teacher-facing Chinese K12 workflow and repeat the same consent, named-student, no-status-change, and teacher-sends-manually limits.
